about_the_game:
Eyes of the ElderWood is an first person adventure horror inspired by Kashubian folklore.

It’s a story that blurs the line between fairy tale and reality, mixed with psychological horror filled with mysteries and dark magic.

Dual-wield Combat

Combine magic with firearms. Draw spells by hand to aid in combat and puzzle-solving, or use a more conventional form of fighting, a revolver. Combining both methods can be crucial in certain encounters to survive.

Demonic Creatures from Legends

Face demons drawn from Kashubian beliefs, myths, and legends. Each demon has a unique appearance, behavior and backstory. Some require a specific approach, others can only be harmed with magic, and some cannot be killed by any means.

Unique Levels, Unique Nightmares

Explore diverse locations with unique visuals, settings, and mechanics. Each level offers a distinct experience and its own enemies.

Retro Visuals and Audio

Experience the nostalgic charm of early 2000s games thanks to vertex lighting, which provides a distinctive old-school look, combined with a bitcrusher effect that recreates the sound quality of games from that era.

Fear That Surrounds You

Your psyche will not only serve as sustenance for certain demons, but it will also make you question whether what you see is real or imagined. The sanity system affects your perception of the game world, potentially causing misperceptions, auditory and visual hallucinations, and in extreme cases, descent into madness that leads to unique sequences which may drive you toward self-destruction.

content_descriptors.notes: Brutal player eliminations, body horror, snuffing snuff as a cultural element and drinking alcohol to boost stats.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or better
